title: Suspicious Motex Landscope management access from untrusted source - BROAD
author: Adama ASSIONGBON (SOC & CTI Consultant), https://linkedin.com/in/adama-assiongbon-9029893a
description: Detects suspicious external access to Motex Landscope management surfaces consistent with CVE-2025-61932 probing. Two detection variants: specific Landscope URIs trigger regardless of User-Agent; generic admin URIs require an automation or scanner User-Agent. Covers browser-UA evasion for high-specificity paths.
